summary: Completed comprehensive testing of OTC/P2P Market page (/admin/users_list/otc) with Overview statistics tab. All backend APIs and frontend features working correctly.

Backend: GET /api/deals/admin/market-stats returns complete aggregates (deals, volumeUsd, commissionEarnedUsd, reservedOnContractUsd, traders, topTraders, popularPositions, rankDistribution, volumeBySection)
Backend: GET /api/deals/otc/all returns {deals, total} with 3 OTC deals
Backend: GET /api/deals/p2p/all returns {deals, total} with 1 P2P deal
Frontend: Admin login successful and redirects to /admin/projects
Frontend: Navigation to /admin/users_list/otc loads correctly
Frontend: Page title 'OTC / P2P рынок' displays
Frontend: 'Обзор' tab is active by default with green color (rgb(4, 165, 132)) and green border
Frontend: KPI stat cards display with real data: Объём торгов ($6.2K), Заработано на комиссии ($310), Зарезервировано в эскроу ($2.0K), Активные сделки (2), Завершённые сделки (1)
Frontend: Top traders table (Топ-трейдеры) displays with data-testid='top-trader-0' showing 2 traders (bob_buterin, alice_nakamoto) with ranks and stats
Frontend: Популярные позиции section shows 4 service types with progress bars (Проекты, Услуги, Соцсеть, NFT)
Frontend: Распределение по рангам section shows 2 ranks (Celestial Master, Cosmic Explorer)
Frontend: Объём по секциям section shows OTC volume $6.2K with 40% completion rate
Frontend: Custom green dropdown for status filter (data-testid='deals-status-filter') works - opens/closes correctly, not native select
Frontend: OTC tab table fits without horizontal scroll (1394px table width < 1920px viewport)
Frontend: OTC tab shows 3 deal rows with all columns visible (ID, Название, Тип, Статус, Услуга, Сумма/цена, Создатель, Контрагент, Эскроу, Дата)
Frontend: Creator and counterparty usernames displayed in green (clickable styling)
Frontend: All 7 tabs present and switchable: Обзор, OTC, P2P, Выводы, Депозиты, Апелляции, Смарт-контракт
Frontend: Tab bar uses green underline for active tab
Frontend: Layout is compact and fits 15.3" screen without horizontal scroll
